description.default: The application (client) ID of the rev-wordpress-intake registration, which the WordPress site sends as the x-rev-client-id header (NFR-008, C-TECH-006). The intake flow's first action compares that header with this value and rejects the request with 401 before any Dataverse write. This is the SECOND control; the first is the signed callback URL (trigger mode Anyone, TAD rev 14, ADR-011). A client ID is a public identifier, not a secret, so it is a plain environment variable and NOT a secret-type variable.
